pages.text: $(bold)Drops$(): 1-3x $(item)chorus fruit$()$(br)and as 10%% to drop a $(item)shulker shell$();$(br)

In this ritual a $(#ad03fc)Shulker$() is spawned using the life energy of a $(#ad03fc)Cube Mob$() and immediately possessed by the summoned $(#ad03fc)Djinni$(). The $(#ad03fc)Possessed Weak Shulker$() will always drop at least one $(item)chorus fruit$() when killed and has a chance to drop $(item)shulker shell$(). $()
Minecraft 1.12 does not include the modern projectile-based Shulker multiplication mechanic.$(br)
